text_block_list.text:
Starting today is the "Summer Training Camp"—
Intensive training to improve skills begins!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here...
The overnight school trip event...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer,
you better stay sharp too!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: After all, when it comes to overnight trip events—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"There's no doubt it's gonna be a non-stop thrill ride
where you can't even afford to blink!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of excitement
is waiting for us... Khh, yeahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Just thinking about it gets my heart pounding so hard
I can't sit stiiiiiiill!!!!

And after riding the bus for several hours,
we finally arrived at the training camp facility—

Maybe because I was horsing around too much on the bus,
I'm suddenly super sleepy now...!!

For now, I'm full of nothing but anxiety, but—
I'll do my best anyway!!
